main_measure.name: mean unusual 2-bar move of short cases (short direction)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 and check > 0; reject: t <= -2 or upper-minus-lower Welch t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, upper minus lower half of |forecast|

reading: A case is the first short bet (forecast rising >= 2 points on the short side from its lowest level since the last bet, reset at flat or side change) in each 2-bar grid cell of a window, measured from its own bar's close; the profile is read from the recorded regime; halves split as |forecast| > median vs <= median; the plan's 'fewer than 30 distinct days' minimum is treated as not observable.
decided_by: Inconclusive: the main measure's t is between -2 and 2 and no reject rule is met.
